name: FaceMesh AI
description: A real-time browser-based facial landmark tracking system. Uses MediaPipe Face Mesh and TensorFlow.js to map a dense mesh of facial points directly on the client — enabling face tracking, AR overlays, and interactive applications without server round-trips.
technicalTakeaway: Running MediaPipe inference entirely in the browser via WebGL eliminates latency from server round-trips and keeps user video data private.
